title: 2.3 Data Science
description: Exhaustive coverage of Data Science disciplines, Big Data characteristics (Volume, Velocity, Variety), privacy issues, anonymization, and IoT from Grade 11 ICT Unit 2.

questions.question: What is Data Science defined as in the curriculum?
options: A blend of tools, algorithms, and machine learning principles used to discover and extract hidden patterns
The physical replacement of damaged RAM sticks after hearing continuous POST beep codes
The design of analog telephone lines for point-to-point voice communications
A proprietary software protocol that exclusively manages relational primary keys
questions.correctAnswer: A blend of tools, algorithms, and machine learning principles used to discover and extract hidden patterns

questions.question: Which three academic disciplines intersect to form the interdisciplinary field of Data Science (Figure 2.24)?
options: Computer Science, Mathematics, and Statistics
Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
Economics, History, and Geography
Sociology, Political Science, and Philosophy
questions.correctAnswer: Computer Science, Mathematics, and Statistics

questions.question: What is a Data Scientist?
options: A professional who uses different types of algorithms to turn vast amounts of data into useful insights
A technician whose sole task is cleaning dust from power supply ventilators
An assembly line worker operating robotic machinery in automobile factories
A legal officer responsible for registering new patent trademarks at municipal offices
questions.correctAnswer: A professional who uses different types of algorithms to turn vast amounts of data into useful insights

questions.question: What is Big Data?
options: A huge volume of data that cannot be processed using traditional methods
A single relational database table containing more than ten records
A high-level Python script that contains more than one hundred lines of code
An optical storage disc with a capacity exceeding seven hundred megabytes
questions.correctAnswer: A huge volume of data that cannot be processed using traditional methods

questions.question: What are the three primary characteristics that define Big Data?
options: Volume, Variety, and Velocity
Voltage, Vibration, and Viscosity
Validity, Veracity, and Value
Variables, Vectors, and Voids
questions.correctAnswer: Volume, Variety, and Velocity

questions.question: What does 'Volume' refer to in the context of Big Data characteristics?
options: Data at Rest: terabytes to exabytes of existing data to process
The loudness of acoustic audio signals emitted during videoconferences
The physical diameter of a hard disk platter inside a server cabinet
The number of sound decibels produced by a vacuum cleaner
questions.correctAnswer: Data at Rest: terabytes to exabytes of existing data to process

questions.question: What does 'Velocity' refer to in the context of Big Data?
options: Data in Motion: streaming data requiring milliseconds to seconds to respond
The maximum travel speed of an autonomous Tesla car on highway lanes
The rotation speed of a CPU cooling fan in revolutions per minute
The transmission speed of light through vacuum space
questions.correctAnswer: Data in Motion: streaming data requiring milliseconds to seconds to respond

questions.question: What does 'Variety' refer to as a characteristic of Big Data?
options: Data in Many Forms: structured, unstructured, text, and multimedia
The number of different programming languages supported by an operating system
The diverse manufacturer brands producing surge protectors and line conditioners
The assortment of font styles available in simple text editors
questions.correctAnswer: Data in Many Forms: structured, unstructured, text, and multimedia

questions.question: According to the textbook, how much data was Facebook generating every day in 2020?
options: 4 petabytes of data every day (equivalent to a million gigabytes)
500 megabytes of data every day
10 terabytes of data every month
100 gigabytes of data every year
questions.correctAnswer: 4 petabytes of data every day (equivalent to a million gigabytes)

questions.question: How many gigabytes are equivalent to the 4 petabytes of data Facebook generated daily in 2020?
options: One million gigabytes
One thousand gigabytes
Ten thousand gigabytes
One hundred million gigabytes
questions.correctAnswer: One million gigabytes

questions.question: What approaches does Data Science apply to effectively process big data?
options: Mathematical and statistical approaches and computer tools
Manual filing cabinets and paper folder indexes
Analog voltage amplifiers and vacuum tube oscillators
Physical punch cards and mechanical sorting gears
questions.correctAnswer: Mathematical and statistical approaches and computer tools

questions.question: How is data science specifically applied in the manufacturing industry?
options: To forecast product demand in order to determine the precise amount of raw material needed
To replace all conveyor belts with manual wheelbarrows
To eliminate quality control checks during production assembly
To calculate electrical power bills without utility meters
questions.correctAnswer: To forecast product demand in order to determine the precise amount of raw material needed

questions.question: How do social media companies utilize data science tools on user information?
options: To achieve personalization of information on social media platforms
To erase all user interaction logs at the end of each session
To prevent users from browsing external website links
To convert all user photos into black-and-white drawings
questions.correctAnswer: To achieve personalization of information on social media platforms

questions.question: What is an important application of data science in the agricultural sector?
options: Weather predictions
Manufacturing synthetic tractors
Bypassing seasonal soil fertilization
Replacing plant biology with mechanical robots
questions.correctAnswer: Weather predictions

questions.question: What is a prominent application of data science in the healthcare sector?
options: Preventive medicine
Increasing administrative patient billing disputes
Eliminating hygiene sterilization protocols in clinics
Replacing physician consultations with commercial retail advertisements
questions.correctAnswer: Preventive medicine

questions.question: How is data science applied in the business sector?
options: Risk management
Manual ledger tallying
Cash vault physical guarding
Paper voucher sorting
questions.correctAnswer: Risk management

questions.question: Why does the application of data science in social networking sites sometimes create societal tension?
options: Because it involves collecting massive amounts of user data, clashing with privacy and regulatory frameworks
Because data science servers consume more than half of the planet's atmospheric oxygen
Because social media companies prohibit users from accessing mathematical websites
Because data science tools permanently erase computer operating systems
questions.correctAnswer: Because it involves collecting massive amounts of user data, clashing with privacy and regulatory frameworks

questions.question: What is Data Anonymization?
options: The process of removing personally identifiable information from a data set
Grouping data into broad categories such as age groups and geographical areas
Backing up files to an external hard drive to prevent hardware failure
Encrypting a hard disk using a biometric fingerprint sensor
questions.correctAnswer: The process of removing personally identifiable information from a data set

questions.question: What is Data Generalization?
options: Bunching data into broad categories such as age groups and geographical areas
Deleting all numeric columns from a relational database table
Translating spoken languages into binary machine language
Removing all external hardware peripherals from a workstation
questions.correctAnswer: Bunching data into broad categories such as age groups and geographical areas

questions.question: What is the primary drawback of applying data anonymization and data generalization techniques?
options: They limit the depth and level of insight that companies can generate from data
They cause sudden hardware overheating in computer storage components
They permanently corrupt the underlying relational database structure
They require high-voltage line conditioners to execute safely
questions.correctAnswer: They limit the depth and level of insight that companies can generate from data

questions.question: How is the Internet of Things (IoT) defined in the unit Key Terms?
options: Interrelated Internet-connected objects that exchange data without human intervention
A global network of libraries storing historical paper manuscripts
A collection of relational database queries written in Microsoft Access
A suite of antivirus utilities that scans for email worms
questions.correctAnswer: Interrelated Internet-connected objects that exchange data without human intervention

questions.question: How is Social Media defined in the unit Key Terms?
options: A medium that facilitates socializing through virtual networks
A physical bulletin board hung in municipal post offices
A telecommunication cable providing high-voltage power to server centers
An automated assembly robot used in car manufacturing plants
questions.correctAnswer: A medium that facilitates socializing through virtual networks

questions.question: Which statement regarding Big Data and traditional data management is accurate?
options: Big data cannot be processed or managed using traditional data processing methods
Big data can be easily managed within a single paper-based office ledger
Traditional spreadsheet files can store unlimited petabytes of streaming data
Big data only occurs when computer systems experience power sags
questions.correctAnswer: Big data cannot be processed or managed using traditional data processing methods

questions.question: What device is used to capture input for Augmented Reality applications?
options: A camera
A barcode wand
A floppy disk drive
A stylus digitizer tablet
questions.correctAnswer: A camera

questions.question: What type of experience does Virtual Reality provide as identified in the unit review matching questions?
options: A fully immersive experience
A partially immersive experience
A non-visual text-only experience
A purely tactile mechanical experience
questions.correctAnswer: A fully immersive experience
